label: A sharp income cut (hypothetical)
rationale: HYPOTHETICAL numbers. Committed money access exceeds what arrives at step 2, so P-ALLOC-01 grades the cut and finance, which produces the reserve-balance level, goes short by more than its sending dial allows. From step 3 the report is never sent; the governor reads the silence as alarm and the settings give their mapped alarm responses (decision Q-004, PROP-SENSE-01). IT support, ranked lowest, is starved of money from step 2, so its backlog report stops from step 3; its backlog then rises to 30 tickets, raising its staff-time requirement, but the governor reads that silence as no intervention, so its hours stay at 10 and the growing shortfall shows only in the definite state.
